name: general-coding-practices
description: General coding project collaboration rules and engineering practices.

interface.shortDescription: Follow project collaboration and coding rules.
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex to confirm plans before design or refactor decisions, protect private information, avoid duplicated code, proactively maintain project rule files such as AGENTS.md, run formatting and static checks, use appropriate dependencies, identify root causes before adding fallbacks or workarounds, and make coroutine-first concurrency decisions in Kotlin projects instead of defaulting to Java thread or blocking synchronization patterns.
defaultPrompt: Plan this coding change and ask for approval before implementation.
Fix this bug by finding the root cause first.
Review this change for duplicated code, privacy-safe examples, linting, and formatting.
Implement this Kotlin change with coroutine-first concurrency decisions.
